description: Retrieves a list of discount coupons from a Stripe account, supporting pagination via `limit`, `starting_after`, and `ending_before`.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for listing coupons, with pagination options.

ending_before.description: A coupon ID for pagination. Returns items created before this object.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: Maximum number of coupon objects to return. Stripe's default (usually 10) applies if omitted.
limit.title: Limit

starting_after.description: A coupon ID for pagination. Returns items created after this object.
starting_after.title: Starting After

inputSchema.title: ListCouponsRequest

name: list_coupons

AppliesTo.description: Details about which products the coupon applies to.

products.description: List of product IDs this coupon applies to.
products.title: Products

AppliesTo.title: AppliesTo

CouponData.description: Details of a Stripe coupon, including discount, duration, and redemption status.

amount_off.description: Monetary amount (smallest currency unit, e.g., cents for USD) deducted. Present for fixed amount discounts.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

applies_to.description: Contains information about which products the coupon applies to.
applies_to.title: Applies To

created.description: Timestamp (Unix epoch seconds) of coupon creation.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., 'usd'), lowercase. Present if `amount_off` is set.
currency.title: Currency

currency_options.description: Coupons defined in each available currency option. Keys are three-letter ISO currency codes.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

duration_in_months.description: Number of months discount persists if `duration` is `repeating`.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

id.description: Unique identifier for the coupon. Example: `co_123xyz`
id.title: Id

livemode.description: Indicates if created in live mode (`true`) or test mode (`false`).
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum redemption count before invalidation. Null means unlimited.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Key-value pairs for additional structured information. Example: `{'department': 'Marketing'}`.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon, displayable to customers. Example: `SUMMER25OFF`.
name.title: Name

percent_off.description: Percentage discount (e.g., 25 for 25%). Present for percentage-based discounts.
percent_off.title: Percent Off

redeem_by.description: Expiration timestamp (Unix epoch seconds). Null if no specific expiration, though `max_redemptions` or deactivation may still apply.
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this coupon has been redeemed.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

valid.description: Indicates if the coupon is currently valid and redeemable (e.g., not expired, within `max_redemptions`, not deactivated).
valid.title: Valid

CouponData.title: CouponData

amount_off.description: Discount amount for the specified currency.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

ListCouponsResponse.description: Response containing a list of coupons and pagination details.

data.description: Array of `CouponData` objects. Empty if no coupons match or exist.
data.title: Data

has_more.description: `true` if more coupon objects are available via pagination.
has_more.title: Has More

object.description: Object type; always 'list' for a list of coupons.
object.title: Object

url.description: API URL of the retrieved list, typically `/v1/coupons`.
url.title: Url

ListCouponsResponse.title: ListCouponsResponse
